spans.s:
(उ) कमु r. 1st cl. (कामयति)
To desire: this root is irregular.

f. (-मा)
Beauty, radiance.
E.
कम to desire, अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-मः)
1 KĀMA the Hindu Cupid or deity of love.
2 Wish, desire.
3 BALARĀMA the brother of KṚṢṆ

The mango tree.
f. (-मा)
Love, desire.
n. (-मं)
1 Semen virile.
2 An object of desire.
3 Willingly, voluntarily.
4 A particle of assent or agreement: see कामम्.
ind.
(in composition,) Following one's own desire, as कामवाद speaking what one lists; कामभक्ष eating whatever one likes; कामचार doing whatever one chooses; in law, a child previous to the imposition of the characteristic cord is all these.
E.
कम to desire, घञ् aff.

ind.
1

Water.
2

The head.
2 Happiness or happily.
4 An expletive.
E.
कम to desire, विच् aff.

mn. (-ठः-ठं)
1 A water jar, especially one made of a hollow gourd or cocoanut, and used by ascetics.
m. (-ठः)
1 A turtle, a tortoise.
2 A bamboo.
3 The name of a Daitya or demon.
4 A porcupine.
f. (-ठी)
A female tortoise, a small one.
E.
कम to desire, &c. अठः Uṇādi affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

(-ठः)
A tortoise.
E.
कमठ the same, अण् pleonasm.

mn. (-लुः-लु)
An earthen or wooden water pot, used by the ascetic and religious student.
2 The waved-leaf fig tree: see प्लक्ष.
E.
क BRAHMĀ or water, and मण्ड ornament or essence, ल from ला to get or give, and डु aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Libidinous, desirous.
2 Beautiful, desirable.
m. (-नः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

KĀMA or love.
3 A tree, (Jonesia asoca.)
E.
कम to desire, affix युच् or ल्युट्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Lustful, libidinous, desirous.
f. (-ना)
Wish, desire.
E.
कम to desire, and युच् aff.

m. (-दः)
A heron.
E.
कमन beautiful, and च्छद plumage.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Pleasing, beautiful, desirable.
E.
कम and अनीयर् affix of the future participle, to be desired.

f. (-ता)
1 Loveliness, beauty.
2 Desirableness.
E.
तल् added to the last, or with त्व, कमनीयत्वं.

m. (-न्धः)
Water. see कबन्ध; also according to some, this is an orthographical compound, of कं and अन्ध, both synonyms of water.

m. (-न्धः)
The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. काम, and अन्ध blind.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Desirous, lustful.
E.
कम and अरन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-लं)
1 A lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphaea nelumbo.)
2

Water.
3

Copper.
4

A medicament, a drug.
5 The bladder.
m. (-लः)
A species of deer.
f. (-ला)
1 A name of LAKṢMĪ.
2 An excellent woman.
E.
कम् water, and अल what adorns, or कम to desire, with कलच् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Libidinous, cupidinous.
mf. (-लः-ला)
A complaint, jaundice, excessive secretion or obstruction of bile.
m. (-लः)
1

Spring.
2

A dry and sterile soil.
E.
काम desire, ला to bring, ड aff.

m. (-दः)
1 A heron: see कङ्क.
2 Petal of the lotus.
E.
कमल, and छद a leaf.

m. (-रः)
A lake &c. where lotuses abound.
E.
कमल, and आकर a mine.

m. (-नः)
An epithet of BRAHMĀ.
E.
कमल a lotus, and आसन seat or abode.

f. (-नी)
A number of lotus flowers, or a place abounding with them.
E.
कमल, इनि and ङीष् affs.

n. (-रं)
Safflower, (Carthamus tinctorius.)
E.
कमल, and उत्तर best, excellent.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Lustful, desirous, cupidinous.
E.
कम to desire, तृच् affix; and इ inserted.

m. (-म्पः)
Tremour, trembling, shaking.
E.
कपि to shake, and अच् affix; also कम्पन, &c.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Trembling, unsteady, shaken.
n. (-नं)
Trembling, quivering.
m. (-नः)
The dewy season. (Nov.-Dec.)
E.
कपि to tremble, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Trembling.
E.
कपि to tremble, शानच् aff.

m. (-क्ष्मा)
Air, wind.
E.
कम्प trembling, and लक्ष्मन् mark or sign.

m. (-कः)
Wind, air.
E.
काकुन् affixed to कपि.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Trembling, agitated.
E.
कम्प, and अन्वित possessed of.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Shaking, shaken, trembling.
(-तं)
Trembling, a trembling, a tremor.
E.
कपि and क्त aff.

m. (-लः)
A plant: see रोचनी: see काम्पिल्ल; also कम्पिल्ल and कम्पील.

m. (-लः)
A country believed to be situated in the north of India: see काम्पिल्ल, &c.
f. (-ली)
The capital city of that region.

m. (-ल्लः)
1 Sunda Rocani, a perfume and drug so called.
2 The name of a country said to be in the north-west of India.
E.
कपि to tremble or shake, इल्ल affix; also काम्पिल or काम्पील, काम्पिल्य, &c.

m. (-लः)
See काम्पिल and काम्पिल्ल; also काम्पीलक.

mfn. (-म्प्रः-म्प्रा-म्प्रं)
Trembling, shaken.
E.
कपि, and रः aff.

r. 1st cl. (-कम्बति)
To go, to move.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Variegated.
m. (-रः)
Variegated, (the colour.)

m. (-लः)
1 A blanket.
2 A chief of the Nāgas or serpents.
3 A small worm.
4 A dewlap.
5 An upper cloth or garment.
6 A sort of deer.
n. (-लं)
Water.
E.
कम to desire, कलः Uṇādi affix, and ब inserted; or कम् the head, water, &c. and बल to be strong, affix अच्.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Clothed with a blanket, &c.
m. (-लः)
A car covered with a woollen cloth or blanket.
E.
कम्बल a blanket, अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
Woollen cloth manufacturer.
E.
कम्बल, and कारक who makes.

n. (-कं)
A kind of carriage, covered with a coarse blanket or woollen cloth, and drawn by oxen.
E.
कम्बल and बह to bear, affixes ण्यत् and कन्.

m. (-यी)
A sort of kite.

f. (-म्बिः)
1 A ladle or spoon.
2 A shoot, a branch or joint of a bamboo.
E.
कम to desire, बिन् affix, or with ङीष् added, कम्बी.

mfn. (-म्बुः-म्बू-म्बु)
Speckled, variegated.
mn. (-म्बुः-म्बु)
1 A conch, a shell.
m. (-म्बुः)
1 A bracelet, a ring.
2 A bivalve shell.
3 An elephant.
4 The neck.
5 A vein or tubular vessel of the body, &c.
E.
कम्ब to go, उ affix, or कम to desire; the form is irr.

mfn. (-म्बूः-म्बू-म्बु)
A thief, a plunderer.
m. (-म्बूः)
A bracelet.
E.
कम to desire, ऊ Uṇādi affix, and बुक् inserted.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A mean person.
m. (-कः)
A conch.
f. (-का)
A tree, (Physalis flexuosa.)
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Physalis flexuosa): see अश्वगन्धा.

f. (-वा)
A neck marked with three lines like a shell, and considered to be indicative of exalted fortune.
E.
कम्बु a shell, and ग्रीवा the neck.

m. (-जः)
1 The name of a country in the north of India, Camboja or

Camboya.
2

A kind of shell.
3 A description of elephant: see काम्बोज.

m. (-जः)
1 A native of Kāmboja, a foreign race going like the Yavanas, with the whole of the head shaved, one of the tribes originally Kṣatriya, but degraded by omission of the essential rites.
2 A horse of the breed of Kamboya or

Kamboja.
3

A white mimosa.
4 A tree, commonly Punnag, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
f. (-जी)
1 A plant, commonly Maṣāni: see माषपर्णी.
2 A white mimosa, as above.
3 The Gunja plant.
E.
कम्बोज Kamboja or Kamboya, a country in the north of India, अण and ङीष् affix: the plants, &c. being supposed indigenous to that district.

f. (-री)
A plant, (Gmelina arborea.)
E.
कम water, भार a burthen, ङीष् affix; also गम्भारी.

n. (-म्भु)
The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
E.
कं water, भू produced.

mfn. (-म्रः-म्रा-म्रं)
1 Desirous, cupidinous.
2 Beautiful, desirable.
E.
कम to desire, रन् aff.

f. (-ला)
RATI the wife of KĀMA.
E.
काम, and कला a part.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Following the dictates of passion or desire.
E.
काम, and कामिन् desirous.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Following one's inclinations.
m. (-रः)
Desire, the operation or influence of desire.
E.
काम, and कार act, who acts.

ind.
According to one's desires, following one's inclinations, indulging desire.
E.
कामकार and तसि aff.

m. (-टः)
1 The paramour of a harlot, a cully.
2 Wanton caresses, harlotry.
E.
काम desire, and कूट a peak or summit.

mfn. (-लिः-लिः-लि)
Libidinous, wanton.
m. (-लिः)
1

Copulation.
2

Amorous sport.
E.
काम love desire, केलि play, sport.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Acting as one pleases.
E.
काम, and ग who goes.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going as one lists.
E.
काम the wish, and गामिन् who goes.

m. (-णः)
1 Passion, affection.
2 An object of sense.
3 Completion, satiety, perfect enjoyment.
E.
काम desire, and गुण a quality or property.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
Going as one lists.
E.
कामं at will, and गामिन् who goes.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Following one's own pleasure, unchecked, unrestrained.
m. (-रः)
Following one's own wishes or pleasure, sensuality, selfishness.
E.
काम, and चार practice.

ind.
According to one's own inclinations.
E.
तसि added to the last.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
1 Desirous, libidinous.
2 Self-willed.
m. (-री)
1 A sparrow. A name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
काम desire, and चारिन् who goes, from चर with णिनि affix; also with ण्वुल् affix, कामचारक.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced or caused by passion or desire.
m. (-जः)
The son of KĀMA.
E.
काम, and ज born; also कामजनित, कामोत्पन्न, &c.

m. (-नः)
The Kokila or Indian cuckoo.
E.
काम, and जान what produces, from जन in the causal form, and घञ् affix; also read कामजनि.

m. (-लः)
See कामताल.

ind.
1 Willingly, consentingly.
2 Passionately.
E.
काम and तसि aff.

m. (-लः)
The Kokila, or Koïl, the Indian cuckoo.
E.
काम, and ताल a musical strain; the song of the Koïl being poetically considered as an incentive to love.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Giving what is wished, granting one's desires.
f. (-दा)
A fabulous cow, the cow of plenty.
E.
काम desire, and द what gives.

f. (-घा)
The cow of plenty.
E.
काम, and दुह to yield milk, affix कप्.

f. (-धुक्)
1 The cow of plenty.
E.
काम, and दुह to give milk, क्विस् aff.

f. (-ती)
1 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
2 The female koïl.
E.
काम desire, and दूती a messenger; also कामदूति and कामदूतिका.

m. (-सी)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
काम CUPID, and ध्वंसिन् an enemy.

m. (-मी)
A brazier.
E.
काम willingly, ध्मा to blow, णिनि aff.

f. (-त्नी)
A name of RATI.
E.
काम KANDARPA, and पत्नी a wife.

m. (-लः)
A name of BALARĀMA, the brother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
काम KĀMA, and पाल who cherishes; being by one legend the paternal uncle of that deity.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Granting what is desired.
E.
काम, and प्रद what yields.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Bound by love.
n. (-द्धं)
A wood.
E.
काम and बद्ध tied.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Eating any thing or every thing.
E.
काम, and भक्ष who eats.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Eating any thing.
E.
काम, and भक्ष्य to be eaten.

ind.
A particle,
1 Of reluctant assent, (well, very well.)
2 Of assent, (willingly, readily.)
3 Of agreement, (very well, so be it.)
4 Of contempt or invidious remark.
5 Agreeably to desire, following the inclination: see काम.

m. (-हः)
The day of full moon in the month Chaitra, (March-April.)
E.
काम the deity, and मह worship; a festival in honour of KĀMA.

m. (-ली)
A name of GAṆEŚA.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Libidinous, lustful, desirous.
E.
कम to desire, in the causal form, and तृच् aff.

mfn. (-पः-पी-पं)
1 Pleasing, beautiful.
2 Taking any or every shape at will.
m. (-पः)
A district lying east of Bengal, the western portion of Asam.
E.
काम desire, and रूप form or figure.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
1 Pleasing, beautiful.
2 Taking any shape at will.
m. (-पी)
1 A Vidyādhara, a kind of subordinate deity.
2 A pole cat.
E.
काम desire, will, रूप form, and इनि aff.

f. (-खा)
A harlot, a courtezan.
E.
काम desire, and रेखा a line.

f. (-ता)
1 Membrum virile.
2 A plant, (Ipomaea quamoclit.)
E.
काम, and लता creeper.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Overcome with desire or passion.
E.
काम, and लोल agitated.

m. (-भः)
1 The mango tree.
2 Spring.
f. (-भा)
Moonlight.
E.
काम, and वल्लभ friend.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Saying any thing at pleasure.
E.
काम, and वाद speech.

mfn. (-न्ता-न्त्री-न्तृ)
Disappointing, preventing.
E.
काम, and विहन्तृ^1 who destroys.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Licentious, dissipated, debauched.
E.
काम, and वृत्त practising.

f. (-द्धिः)
1 A shrub, commonly Kāmaja, of supposed aphrodisial properties.
2 Increase of passion or desire.
E.
काम, and वृद्धि increase.

f. (-न्ता)
Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
E.
काम, and वृन्ता a flower stalk.

m. (-रः)
1 The shaft of

KĀMADEVA.
2

The mango.
E.
काम, and शर an arrow.

m. (-गः)
Attainment of desired objects.
E.
काम, and संयोग union.

Spring.
2

The mango.
E.
काम and सखि a friend.

m. (-तः)
A name of ANIRUDDHA.
E.
काम, and सुत a son; also similar compounds, as कामपुत्र, &c.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of one's own accord.
E.
काम, हेतु cause, वुञ् aff.

m. (-ग्निः)
Passion, lust, violent desire.
E.
काम, and अग्नि fire.

m. (-शः)
1 A finger nail.
2 Membrum virile.
E.
काम, and अङ्कुश shoot.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.)
E.
काम, and अङ्ग the body or form.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
In love, affected by love or desire.
E.
काम, and आतुर diseased.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
1 Licentious, libidinous.
2 Desiring, wishing for.
E.
काम, and आत्मन् self.

f. (-ता)
1 Passion, lust.
2 Wish, desire.
E.
कामात्म and तल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Influenced or overcome by love.
E.
काम, and अधिष्ठित placed over.

m. (-रः)
1 The influence of passion or desire.
2 The aspiration of the will.
3 The part of the Śāstra which relates to human wishes or desires.
E.
काम, and अधिकार superintendence.

m. (-लः)
Passion, lust, violent desire.
E.
काम, and अनल fire.

n. (-धं)
An arrow of KĀMADEVA.
m. (-धः)
1 Membrum virile.
2 The mango tree.
E.
काम, and आयुध a weapon.

m. (-युः)
Name of GARUḌA the bird of VIṢṆU.
E.
काम, and आयुस् life; existing at will.

n. (-ण्यं)
A handsome grove or wood.
E.
काम desirable, and अरण्य a forest.

m. (-रिः)
A mineral substance used in medicine, a sort of pyrites: see विटमाक्षिक.
E.
काम love, and अरि an enemy.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
In love, afflicted by love or passion.
E.
काम, and आर्त्त pained.

m. (-लुः)
A red sort of mountain ebony.

m. (-यः)
Coldness, stoicism, mortification or suppression of the passions.
E.
काम, and अवसाय destruction.

f. (-ता)
The power of suppressing desire, self-denial or mortification.
E.
कामावसायिन् and तल् affix, or with त्व, कामावसायित्व n. (-त्वं).

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Who or what suppresses or destroys passion or desire.
E.
काम, and अवसायितृ destroying.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Destructive of love or desire, one who suppresses desire, &c.
E.
कामावसाय and इनि aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Impassioned, in love, overcome with desire or passion.
E.
काम, and आसक्त attached.

f. (-क्तिः)
Passion, desire.
E.
काम, and आसक्ति attachment.

m. (-मिः)
A libidinous man, a lecher.
f. (-मिः)
A name of RATI the wife of KĀMA.
E.
कम to desire, कि affix; the pen. becomes long.

m. (-कः)
A kind of wild duck.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ता)
Love, desire.
E.
कामिन् and तल् affix; also with त्व, कामित्व.

mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि)
1 Impassioned, fond, loving, wanton.
2 Cupidinous, desirous.
m. (-मी)
1 The moon.
2 A lover, an uxorious husband.
3 The ruddy goose.
4 A pigeon.
5 A sparrow.
f. (-नी)
1 A loving or affectionate woman.
2 A timid woman.
3 A woman in general.
4 Spirituous liquor.
5 A climbing plant.
E.
कम to desire, and णिनि aff.

m. (-शः)
A plant, (Morunga guilandina, &c.) see शोभाञ्जन.

m. (-लः)
A kind of betel, commonly रामगुवाक.
E.
काम desire, ईलच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
Cupidinous, desirous, lustful, libidinous.
m. (-कः)
1 A plant, Aśoka, (Jonesia asoca.)
2 A creeping plant, (Gaertnera racemosa.)
3 A sparrow.
4 A bow.
f. (-का)
A woman desirous of wealth, food, &c.
(-की)
A woman libidinous or lustful.
E.
कम to desire, उकञ् affix, fem. टाप् or ङीष्.

n. (-कं)
Oblation of water to deceased friends, &c. exclusive of those for whom it is directed by law.
E.
काम will, and उदक water; being given according to the inclination of the giver.

f. (-दा)
A Rāgiṇī, one of the female personifications of the musical modes.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Overcome with passion or desire.
E.
काम, and उपहत struck.

m. (-ल्यः)
1 A perfume, commonly Sunda

Rocani.
2
A country: see the preceding; also काम्पिल्ल, &c.

f. (-का)
See the preceding.

m. (-कः)
Gruel, barley water, &c.

m. (-कः)
A dealer in shells, a vender of ornaments made of them, &c.
E.
कम्बु a shell, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-म्यः-म्या-म्यं)
1 Agreeable, desirable, amiable.
2 Performed through the desire of some advantage, (a religious ceremony, &c.)
2 Optional, supererogatory, performed for some particular object, and opposed to the नित्यकर्म्म or fixed and indispensable observance.
4 Relating to desire, will, &c.
5 Done through lust or passion.
E.
काम desire, love, &c. and यत् aff.

f. (-गीः)
A pleasing sound, an agreeable speech or song.
E.
काम्य, and गिर् speech.

n. (-त्वं)
1 Supererogation, will, pleasure.
2 Love, desire.
E.
काम्य, and त्व affix; also with तल्, काम्यता.

n. (-नं)
1 An acceptable or desirable gift.
2 A voluntary gift.
E.
काम्य, and दान a gift.

n. (-णं)
Voluntary death, suicide.
E.
काम्य, and मरण dying.

m. (-यः)
The purpose of deriving benefit from any act.
E.
काम्य, and अभिप्राय intention.

mfn. (-म्लः-म्ला-म्लं)
Slightly acid, acidulous.
E.
का dimin. अम्ल sour.
